About the Wednesday Night Trails group ride

Wednesday Night Trails is a mountain bike group ride in Kalispell, MT. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:45 pm from Herron Park.

Wheaton’s Cycle’s weekly trail ride at Herron Park. It is fast, with 12 to 24 miles and a lot of climbing. Bring lights. The shop lists extra rides on its Facebook page.
